title: How to use legal document management software on Mac: voice help for assistants
metaTitle: Legal Document Management Software Help for Mac Assistants
description: Improve your document workflow with Lazur. Learn how a Mac voice assistant helps legal assistants manage files, email, and drafting tasks faster.
intro: Legal document management software is essential for keeping track of case files, but the manual effort required to organize these documents often slows you down. If you spend your day switching between Finder, Word, and Outlook to locate files or format drafts, you know how quickly that time disappears. Lazur acts as a voice-powered layer on your Mac, helping you navigate these tools without constant clicking.
tldr: Lazur lives in your Mac notch and helps you control apps with your voice.

Hold the fn key to dictate text directly into any legal document or email.
Lazur does not click buttons for you, but it guides you through complex workflows.
Your data remains private, and Lazur does not store your documents.

blocks.text: Legal assistants often juggle multiple windows. You might have Clio open for matter management, Word for drafting a motion, and Outlook for client communication. Finding the right file in the Finder can take several clicks, especially if your firm uses a deep folder structure. Lazur helps by answering your questions about what is on your screen. When you hold ⌥ ⌘, you can ask where a specific folder is or how to find a file path. Lazur points to the location, saving you from manual searching.
Reducing administrative overhead in your daily workflow

Administrative tasks like time entry and billing are necessary but tedious. Many legal assistants lose hours every week simply moving data between systems. If you use tools like MyCase or Clio, you likely spend time copying information from an email into a billing field. While Lazur does not click buttons for you, it can guide you through the process if you forget a specific menu path. You can ask, how do I add a new time entry in Clio, and Lazur will walk you through the steps one click at a time.

Always ensure your use of AI tools complies with your firm's internal policies regarding client data and confidentiality. Lazur does not store your documents or use them to train models, but you must follow your employer's rules on handling sensitive information.
blocks.title: Data Privacy and Compliance

blocks.text: Drafting motions or letters in Word on a Mac requires precision. You need to manage headers, footers, and page numbers while maintaining strict formatting standards. Instead of hunting through the ribbon, hold the fn key to dictate text directly into your document. Lazur handles the formatting, allowing you to focus on the legal content. If you need to apply a specific style, ask Lazur where the style gallery is located. It will draw a circle around the correct button to guide your next move.

Email is the lifeblood of a law firm. Triaging messages can easily consume 28 percent of your workweek. When you need to draft a quick response, use Lazur to dictate your reply. This is faster than typing, especially when you are catching up on a long thread. If you are struggling with a specific Outlook feature, such as setting up a rule to filter case-specific emails, ask Lazur to explain the steps. It provides clear, actionable instructions without you needing to leave your inbox.
How to use Lazur for legal research

Legal research often involves opening many tabs and reading through lengthy PDFs. Lazur features a research capability that runs in its own Chrome tabs. You can ask it to summarize the key points of a document or find information across multiple sources. It returns a report, which you can then review. This saves you from manually switching between browser windows and trying to synthesize information yourself. Use this for preliminary research before you dive into the primary source material.

blocks.text: To avoid these issues, establish a consistent routine. Use Apple Reminders to prompt yourself to track time. If you use a tool like Clio Drive, ensure it is properly mapped in your Finder. If you ever get stuck, use Lazur to point out the correct folder or menu option. This keeps you focused on your work rather than the mechanics of the software.

faq.question: Can Lazur edit my legal documents directly?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons, edit files, or operate other apps for you. It serves as a guide and a voice assistant to help you navigate your Mac more efficiently.

faq.question: Is Lazur safe for sensitive legal data?
faq.answer: Lazur listens and looks at your screen only while you hold the shortcut. Audio and screenshots are sent to AI providers to answer your questions and are not stored. Your content is never used to train AI models.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with my specific practice management software?
faq.answer: Lazur works with any application on your Mac, including browser-based tools like Clio or MyCase. It provides guidance and answers questions regardless of the specific software you use.

faq.question: How do I get started with Lazur on my Mac?
faq.answer: You can download Lazur and start a 3-day Pro trial without a credit card. Once installed, you can begin using the voice commands immediately.
